verses.original: וּכְכַלּ֣וֹת כָּל־ זֹ֗את יָצְא֨וּ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הַֽנִּמְצְאִים֮ לְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֒ וַיְשַׁבְּר֣וּ הַמַּצֵּב֣וֹת וַיְגַדְּע֣וּ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֡ים וַיְנַתְּצ֣וּ אֶת־ הַ֠בָּמוֹת וְאֶת־ הַֽמִּזְבְּחֹ֞ת מִכָּל־ יְהוּדָ֧ה וּבִנְיָמִ֛ן וּבְאֶפְרַ֥יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה עַד־ לְכַלֵּ֑ה וַיָּשׁ֜וּבוּ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אִ֥ישׁ לַאֲחֻזָּת֖וֹ לְעָרֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḵal·lō·wṯ kāl- zōṯ yā·ṣə·’ū kāl- yiś·rā·’êl han·nim·ṣə·’îm lə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh way·šab·bə·rū ham·maṣ·ṣê·ḇō·wṯ way·ḡad·də·‘ū hā·’ă·šê·rîm way·nat·tə·ṣū ’eṯ- hab·bā·mō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·bə·ḥōṯ mik·kāl yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·min ū·ḇə·’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh ‘aḏ- lə·ḵal·lêh way·yā·šū·ḇū kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’îš la·’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw lə·‘ā·rê·hem
verses.literal: When all this had ended the Israelites in attendance went out to the cities of Judah and broke up the sacred pillars chopped down the Asherah poles and tore down the high places and altars throughout Judah and Benjamin as well as in Ephraim and Manasseh until they had utterly destroyed them all Then all the Israelites . . . returned to their cities each to his own property
verses.literalPt: Acabado tudo isso, todos os de Israel que se acharam presentes saíram pelas cidades de Judá, despedaçaram as colunas, cortaram os Aserins e demoliram os altos e altares em toda a Judá e Benjamim, como também em Efraim e Manassés, até que destruíram tudo. Depois, voltaram todos os filhos de Israel, cada um para a sua possessão, e entraram nas suas cidades.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד יְחִזְקִיָּ֡הוּ אֶת־ מַחְלְק֣וֹת הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ֠הַלְוִיִּם עַֽל־ מַחְלְקוֹתָ֞ם אִ֣ישׁ׀ כְּפִ֣י עֲבֹדָת֗וֹ לַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְלַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְעֹלָ֖ה וְלִשְׁלָמִ֑ים לְשָׁרֵת֙ וּלְהֹד֣וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֔ל בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֖י מַחֲנ֥וֹת יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ’eṯ- maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim ‘al- maḥ·lə·qō·w·ṯām ’îš kə·p̄î ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw lak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lal·wî·yim lə·‘ō·lāh wə·liš·lā·mîm lə·šā·rêṯ ū·lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ ū·lə·hal·lêl bə·ša·‘ă·rê ma·ḥă·nō·wṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Hezekiah reestablished the divisions of the priests and Levites . . . each of them according to their duties as priests or Levites for the burnt offerings and peace offerings for ministry for giving thanks and for singing praises at the gates of the LORD’s dwelling
verses.literalPt: Ezequias organizou as turmas dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, segundo as suas turmas, cada um segundo o seu serviço, sacerdotes e levitas, para os holocaustos e ofertas pacíficas e para ministrarem, renderem ação de graças e cantarem louvores nas portas do arraial de Jeová.

verses.original: וּמְנָת֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ מִן־ רְכוּשׁ֜וֹ לָעֹל֗וֹת לְעֹלוֹת֙ הַבֹּ֣קֶר וְהָעֶ֔רֶב וְהָ֣עֹל֔וֹת לַשַּׁבָּת֖וֹת וְלֶחֳדָשִׁ֣ים וְלַמֹּעֲדִ֑ים כַּכָּת֖וּב בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mə·nāṯ ham·me·leḵ min- rə·ḵū·šōw lā·‘ō·lō·wṯ lə·‘ō·lō·wṯ hab·bō·qer wə·hā·‘e·reḇ wə·hā·‘ō·lō·wṯ laš·šab·bā·ṯō·wṯ wə·le·ḥo·ḏā·šîm wə·lam·mō·‘ă·ḏîm kak·kā·ṯūḇ bə·ṯō·w·raṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The king contributed from his own possessions for the regular morning and evening . . . burnt offerings and for the burnt offerings on the Sabbaths New Moons and appointed feasts as written in the Law of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Também determinou a parte que tocava ao rei, dar da sua fazenda para os holocaustos, para os holocaustos da manhã e da tarde, e os holocaustos dos sábados, das luas novas e das festas fixas, como está escrito na lei de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָעָם֙ לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לָתֵ֕ת מְנָ֥ת הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְמַ֥עַן יֶחֶזְק֖וּ בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·‘ām lə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim lā·ṯêṯ mə·nāṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim lə·ma·‘an ye·ḥez·qū bə·ṯō·w·raṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Moreover, he commanded the people living in Jerusalem to make a contribution for the priests and Levites so that they could devote themselves to the Law of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ordenou, além disso, ao povo que morava em Jerusalém que desse a porção pertencente aos sacerdotes e aos levitas, para que se pudessem entregar à lei de Jeová.

verses.original: וְכִפְרֹ֣ץ הַדָּבָ֗ר הִרְבּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּגָ֗ן תִּיר֤וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָר֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ וְכֹ֖ל תְּבוּאַ֣ת שָׂדֶ֑ה וּמַעְשַׂ֥ר הַכֹּ֛ל לָרֹ֖ב הֵבִֽיאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵip̄·rōṣ had·dā·ḇār hir·bū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl rê·šîṯ dā·ḡān tî·rō·wōš wə·yiṣ·hār ū·ḏə·ḇaš wə·ḵōl tə·ḇū·’aṯ śā·ḏeh ū·ma‘·śar hak·kōl lā·rōḇ hê·ḇî·’ū
verses.literal: As soon as the order went out the Israelites . . . generously provided the firstfruits of the grain new wine oil and honey and of all the produce of the field and they brought in an abundance a tithe of everything
verses.literalPt: Logo que essa ordem se divulgou, os filhos de Israel deram em abundância as primícias de trigo, mosto, azeite, mel e de toda a novidade do campo; e trouxeram em abundância o dízimo de tudo.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וִֽיהוּדָ֗ה הַיּֽוֹשְׁבִים֮ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֒ גַּם־ הֵ֗ם מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן וּמַעְשַׂ֣ר קָֽדָשִׁ֔ים הַמְקֻדָּשִׁ֖ים לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם הֵבִ֕יאוּ וַֽיִּתְּנ֖וּ עֲרֵמ֥וֹת עֲרֵמֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh hay·yō·wō·šə·ḇîm bə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh gam- hêm ma‘·śar bā·qār wā·ṣōn ū·ma‘·śar qā·ḏā·šîm ham·qud·dā·šîm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem hê·ḇî·’ū way·yit·tə·nū ‘ă·rê·mō·wṯ ‘ă·rê·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: And the Israelites . . . and Judahites who lived in the cities of Judah also brought a tithe of their herds and flocks and a tithe of the holy things consecrated to the LORD their God and they laid them in large heaps . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel e de Judá que moravam nas cidades de Judá trouxeram também o dízimo de bois e de ovelhas e o dízimo de coisas dedicadas que foram consagradas a Jeová, seu Deus, e depositaram-nas em montões.

verses.original: בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֔י הֵחֵ֥לּוּ הָעֲרֵמ֖וֹת לְיִסּ֑וֹד וּבַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י כִּלּֽוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·li·šî hê·ḥêl·lū hā·‘ă·rê·mō·wṯ lə·yis·sō·wḏ ū·ḇa·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î kil·lū
verses.literal: In the third month they began building up the heaps and they finished in the seventh month
verses.literalPt: No terceiro mês, começaram a formar os montões e, no sétimo mês, acabaram.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ וְהַשָּׂרִ֔ים וַיִּרְא֖וּ אֶת־ הָעֲרֵמ֑וֹת וַֽיְבָרֲכוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū wə·haś·śā·rîm way·yir·’ū ’eṯ- hā·‘ă·rê·mō·wṯ way·ḇā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·’êṯ ‘am·mōw yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: When Hezekiah and his officials came and viewed the heaps they blessed the LORD and His people Israel
verses.literalPt: Vindo Ezequias e os príncipes a ver os montões, bendisseram a Jeová e ao seu povo de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּדְרֹ֣שׁ יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עַל־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֛ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם עַל־ הָעֲרֵמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḏ·rōš yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘al- hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim ‘al- hā·‘ă·rê·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and Levites . . . about the heaps
verses.literalPt: Então, perguntou Ezequias aos sacerdotes e aos levitas acerca dos montões.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו עֲזַרְיָ֧הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הָרֹ֖אשׁ לְבֵ֣ית צָד֑וֹק וַ֠יֹּאמֶר מֵהָחֵ֨ל הַתְּרוּמָ֜ה לָבִ֣יא בֵית־ יְהוָ֗ה אָכ֨וֹל וְשָׂב֤וֹעַ וְהוֹתֵר֙ עַד־ לָר֔וֹב כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ בֵּרַ֣ךְ אֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ וְהַנּוֹתָ֖ר אֶת־ הֶהָמ֥וֹן הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ‘ă·zar·yā·hū hak·kō·hên hā·rōš lə·ḇêṯ ṣā·ḏō·wq way·yō·mer mê·hā·ḥêl hat·tə·rū·māh lā·ḇî ḇêṯ- Yah·weh ’ā·ḵō·wl wə·śā·ḇō·w·a‘ wə·hō·w·ṯêr ‘aḏ- lā·rō·wḇ kî Yah·weh bê·raḵ ’eṯ- ‘am·mōw wə·han·nō·w·ṯār ’eṯ- he·hā·mō·wn haz·zeh
verses.literal: and Azariah the chief priest of the household of Zadok . . . answered him Since the people began to bring their contributions into the house of the LORD we have had enough to eat and there is plenty left over . . . because the LORD has blessed His people this great abundance is what is left over
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe o sumo sacerdote Azarias, da casa de Zadoque: Desde que o povo começou a trazer as oblações para a Casa de Jeová, temos comido e nos temos fartado delas, e nos tem sobejado bastante, porque Jeová abençoou ao seu povo, e os sobejos constituem essa abastança.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ לְהָכִ֧ין לְשָׁכ֛וֹת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּכִֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū lə·hā·ḵîn lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh way·yā·ḵî·nū
verses.literal: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare storerooms in the house of the LORD and they did so
verses.literalPt: Ezequias ordenou que se aprontassem celeiros na Casa de Jeová; e os aprontaram.

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ הַתְּרוּמָ֧ה וְהַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֛ר וְהַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֤ם נָגִיד֙ כּוֹנַנְיָהוּ הַלֵּוִ֔י וְשִׁמְעִ֥י אָחִ֖יהוּ מִשְׁנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- hat·tə·rū·māh wə·ham·ma·‘ă·śêr wə·haq·qo·ḏā·šîm be·’ĕ·mū·nāh wa·‘ă·lê·hem nā·ḡîḏ kō·nan·yå̄·hū hal·lê·wî wə·šim·‘î ’ā·ḥî·hū miš·neh
verses.literal: And they faithfully brought in - the contributions tithes and dedicated gifts Conaniah the Levite was the officer in charge of them and his brother Shimei was second
verses.literalPt: Ali, recolheram fielmente as oblações, e os dízimos, e as coisas dedicadas; e delas tinha cargo o levita Conanias, e, depois dele, Simei, seu irmão.

verses.original: וִֽיחִיאֵ֡ל וַ֠עֲזַזְיָהוּ וְנַ֨חַת וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֜ל וִֽירִימ֤וֹת וְיוֹזָבָד֙ וֶאֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְיִסְמַכְיָ֔הוּ וּמַ֖חַת וּבְנָיָ֑הוּ פְּקִידִ֗ים מִיַּ֤ד כָּונַנְיָהוּ וְשִׁמְעִ֣י אָחִ֔יו בְּמִפְקַד֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ נְגִ֥יד בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wî·ḥî·’êl wa·‘ă·zaz·yā·hū wə·na·ḥaṯ wa·‘ă·śā·h·’êl wî·rî·mō·wṯ wə·yō·w·zā·ḇāḏ we·’ĕ·lî·’êl wə·yis·maḵ·yā·hū ū·ma·ḥaṯ ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū pə·qî·ḏîm mî·yaḏ kå̄·w·nan·yå̄·hū wə·šim·‘î ’ā·ḥîw bə·mip̄·qaḏ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ham·me·leḵ wa·‘ă·zar·yā·hū nə·ḡîḏ bêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Jehiel Azaziah Nahath Asahel Jerimoth Jozabad Eliel Ismachiah Mahath and Benaiah were overseers under the authority of Conaniah and his brother Shimei by appointment of King Hezekiah and of Azariah the chief official of the house of God
verses.literalPt: Jeiel, Azarias, Naate, Asael, Jerimote, Jozabade, Eliel, Ismaquias, Maate e Benaia eram superintendentes sob a direção de Conanias e de seu irmão Simei, por mandado do rei Ezequias e de Azarias, chefe da Casa de Deus.

verses.original: וְקוֹרֵ֨א בֶן־ יִמְנָ֤ה הַלֵּוִי֙ הַשּׁוֹעֵ֣ר לַמִּזְרָ֔חָה עַ֖ל נִדְב֣וֹת הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים לָתֵת֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וְקָדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qō·w·rê ḇen- yim·nāh hal·lê·wî haš·šō·w·‘êr lam·miz·rā·ḥāh ‘al niḏ·ḇō·wṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·ṯêṯ tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh wə·qā·ḏə·šê haq·qo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: Kore son of Imnah the Levite the keeper of the East Gate was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God distributing the contributions to the LORD and the consecrated gifts
verses.literalPt: O levita Coré, filho de Imná e guarda da Porta Oriental, estava encarregado das ofertas voluntárias que se faziam a Deus, para distribuir as oblações de Jeová e as coisas santíssimas.

verses.original: וְעַל־ יָד֡וֹ עֵ֣דֶן וּ֠מִנְיָמִן וְיֵשׁ֨וּעַ וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֜הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֧הוּ וּשְׁכַנְיָ֛הוּ בְּעָרֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה לָתֵ֤ת לַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ בְּמַחְלְק֔וֹת כַּגָּד֖וֹל כַּקָּטָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yā·ḏōw ‘ê·ḏen ū·min·yā·min wə·yê·šū·a‘ ū·šə·ma‘·yā·hū ’ă·mar·yā·hū ū·šə·ḵan·yā·hū bə·‘ā·rê hak·kō·hă·nîm be·’ĕ·mū·nāh lā·ṯêṯ la·’ă·ḥê·hem bə·maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ kag·gā·ḏō·wl kaq·qā·ṭān
verses.literal: Under his authority Eden Miniamin Jeshua Shemaiah Amariah and Shecaniah faithfully distributed portions to their fellow priests in their cities . . . according to their divisions old and young alike
verses.literalPt: Debaixo das suas ordens, tinham Éden, Miniamim, Jesua, Semaías, Amarias, e Secanias, nas cidades dos sacerdotes, o ofício de fazer a distribuição por turmas a seus irmãos, pequenos e grandes,

verses.original: מִלְּבַ֞ד הִתְיַחְשָׂ֣ם לִזְכָרִ֗ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁל֤וֹשׁ שָׁנִים֙ וּלְמַ֔עְלָה לְכָל־ הַבָּ֥א לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֖ה לִדְבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֑וֹ לַעֲב֣וֹדָתָ֔ם בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֖ם כְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mil·lə·ḇaḏ hiṯ·yaḥ·śām liz·ḵā·rîm mib·ben šā·lō·wōš šā·nîm ū·lə·ma‘·lāh lə·ḵāl hab·bā lə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh liḏ·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw la·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏā·ṯām bə·miš·mə·rō·w·ṯām kə·maḥ·lə·qō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: In addition they distributed portions to the males registered by genealogy who were three years of age . . . or older to all who would enter the house of the LORD for their daily . . . duties for service in the responsibilities of their divisions
verses.literalPt: excluídos os que foram registrados nas genealogias dos homens, desde a idade de três anos e daí para cima, a saber, todos os que entravam na Casa de Jeová, como exigia o dever de cada dia, pelo seu serviço nos seus cargos segundo as suas turmas.

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת הִתְיַחֵ֤שׂ הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָ֑עְלָה בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם בְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ hiṯ·ya·ḥêś hak·kō·hă·nîm lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem wə·hal·wî·yim mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh ū·lə·mā·‘ə·lāh bə·miš·mə·rō·w·ṯê·hem bə·maḥ·lə·qō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: and to the priests enrolled according to their families in the genealogy as well as to the Levites twenty years of age . . . or older according to their responsibilities and divisions
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao registro dos sacerdotes, foi ele feito segundo as suas famílias, e o dos levitas de vinte anos e daí para cima foi feito segundo os seus cargos nas suas turmas,

verses.original: וּלְהִתְיַחֵ֗שׂ בְּכָל־ טַפָּ֧ם נְשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֥ם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל־ קָהָ֑ל כִּ֥י בֶאֱמוּנָתָ֖ם יִתְקַדְּשׁוּ־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·hiṯ·ya·ḥêś bə·ḵāl ṭap·pām nə·šê·hem ū·ḇə·nê·hem ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯê·hem lə·ḵāl qā·hāl kî ḇe·’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯām yiṯ·qad·də·šū- qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The genealogy included all the little ones wives sons and daughters of the whole assembly For they had faithfully consecrated themselves as holy
verses.literalPt: e o de todos os seus pequeninos, mulheres, filhos e filhas foi feito por toda a corporação, porque no seu ofício se houveram com fidelidade.

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים בִּשְׂדֵ֨י מִגְרַ֤שׁ עָרֵיהֶם֙ בְּכָל־ עִ֣יר וָעִ֔יר אֲנָשִׁ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לָתֵ֣ת מָנ֗וֹת לְכָל־ זָכָר֙ בַּכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּלְכָל־ הִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ בַּלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hă·nîm biś·ḏê miḡ·raš ‘ā·rê·hem bə·ḵāl ‘îr wā·‘îr ’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer niq·qə·ḇū bə·šê·mō·wṯ lā·ṯêṯ mā·nō·wṯ lə·ḵāl zā·ḵār bak·kō·hă·nîm ū·lə·ḵāl- hiṯ·ya·ḥêś bal·wî·yim
verses.literal: As for the priests the descendants of Aaron who lived on the farmlands around . . . each of their cities or in any other city . . . men were designated by name to distribute a portion to every male among the priests and to every Levite listed by the genealogies
verses.literalPt: Além disso, os sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, que moravam nos arrabaldes das suas cidades, em cada cidade, tinham homens, designados por nome, para fazer a distribuição a todos os homens dos sacerdotes e a todos os levitas que foram registrados.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ כָּזֹ֛את יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכָל־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַטּ֤וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר֙ וְהָ֣אֱמֶ֔ת לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś kā·zōṯ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū bə·ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh way·ya·‘aś haṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·hay·yā·šār wə·hā·’ĕ·meṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw
verses.literal: So this is what Hezekiah did throughout Judah He did what was good and upright and true before the LORD his God
verses.literalPt: Assim fez Ezequias em todo o Judá. Fez o que era bom, reto e fiel perante Jeová, seu Deus.

verses.original: וּבְכָֽל־ מַעֲשֶׂ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֵחֵ֣ל׀ בַּעֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים וּבַתּוֹרָה֙ וּבַמִּצְוָ֔ה לִדְרֹ֖שׁ לֵֽאלֹהָ֑יו בְּכָל־ לְבָב֥וֹ עָשָׂ֖ה וְהִצְלִֽיחַ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śeh ’ă·šer- hê·ḥêl ba·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ bêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḇat·tō·w·rāh ū·ḇam·miṣ·wāh liḏ·rōš lê·lō·hāw bə·ḵāl lə·ḇā·ḇōw ‘ā·śāh wə·hiṣ·lî·aḥ
verses.literal: He acted with all his heart in every work that he began in the service of the house of God and in the law and the commandments in order to seek his God And so he prospered
verses.literalPt: Em toda a sua obra que começou no serviço da Casa de Deus, e na lei, e nos mandamentos, para buscar ao seu Deus, ele o fez de todo o seu coração e foi bem sucedido.
